chat-headline-text: Headline text displayed for the chatbot section.
chat-input-placeholder: Placeholder text inside the message input field, prompting the user to type a message.
chat-send-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Send' button to send a message.
chat-export-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Export chat' button to export chat history.
chat-export-popup-title: Title of the export popup window.
chat-export-popup-export-button: Button label for exporting chat in the popup.
chat-export-popup-cancel-button: Button label for canceling the export action in the popup.
chat-export-popup-format-label: Label for selecting the format in the export popup.
chat-export-error: Error message shown when there is nothing to export.
chat-resize-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Resize chat' button, used to resize the chat window.
chat-maximize-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Maximize chat' button, used to enlarge the chat window.
chat-minimize-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Minimize chat' button, used to reduce the chat window size.
chat-close-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Close chat' button, which also deletes chat history.
chat-copy-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Copy answer' button, used to copy the chatbot's response.
chat-accurate-feedback-button-title: Tooltip text for the feedback button indicating the answer was correct.
chat-fairly-accurate-feedback-button-tit: Tooltip text for the feedback button indicating the answer was fairly accurate.
chat-inaccurate-feedback-button-title: Tooltip text for the feedback button indicating the answer was inaccurate.
chat-banner-help-button: Button text to navigate to the FAQ section.
chat-banner-close-button: Button text to close the information banner displayed in the chat.
chat-restore-session-text: Text offering the option to restore the previous session.
chat-reference-list-button: Button text for showing references related to the chatbot's response.
chat-answer-processing: Message displayed when the chatbot is processing the user's question.
chat-greeting: Initial greeting message shown when the chat starts.
chat-api-load-error: Error message shown when there is an issue connecting to the chatbot
chat-api-response-error: Error message shown when there is an error in the server's response.
chat-api-stream-error: Error message shown when streaming is not supported on the server.
chat-missing-config: Error message shown when chatbot configuration is missing.
chat-pdf-title: Title for exported PDF, describing the content as an AI-generated answer from the chatbot.
chat-pdf-banner-text: Disclaimer banner text in the exported PDF, noting that the answer is AI-generated and may contain errors.
chat-api-references-not-found-error:
Error message when references cannot be found, with $1 as a placeholder for specific reference details.

Parameters:
* $1 - Reference id
chat-banner-label: Label indicating that the chatbot responses are AI-based and not from live personnel.
chat-close-popup-info-label: Information in a popup that closing the chat will delete the current conversation.
chat-close-popup-close-and-export-btn-la: Button text for exporting and then closing the chat.
chat-close-popup-close-btn-label: Button text for just closing the chat.
chat-close-popup-cancel-btn-label: Button text to cancel closing the chat.
chat-close-popup-header: Header title for the popup that confirms closing the chatbot.
chat-dismiss-error-button-title: Tooltip text for dismissing or closing an error message.
chat-copy-to-clipboard: Message shown after successfully copying an answer to the clipboard.
chat-popup-feedback-problem-heading: Header text asking which problem occurred.
chat-popup-feedback-problem-cause: Label for selecting the suspected cause of a problem.
chat-popup-feedback-problem-desc: Label for describing the problem in detail.
chat-popup-feedback-problem-mail: Label for an email address to follow up on the feedback.
chat-popup-feedback-problem-optional: Text indicating that certain feedback fields are optional.
chat-popup-feedback-send-button-label: Label for the button to send feedback about a problem.
chat-config-feedback-problem: List of reportable problems in feedback.
chat-config-feedback-cause: List of suspected causes in feedback options.
chatbot-droplet-meta-name: Name for the chatbot metadata droplet.
chatbot-droplet-meta-description: Description of the metadata section for the chatbot.
chatbot-admin-module-stats-label: Label for chatbot statistics in the admin module.
chatbotadmin: Label for the chatbot administration section.
chatbot-admin-module-stats-error: Error message shown when statistics fail to load in the admin module.
chatbot-admin-module-stats-feedback: Label for feedback statistics in the admin module.
chatbot-admin-module-stats-feedback-stat: Label for statistics on accurate feedback.
Label for statistics on neutral feedback.
Label for statistics on negative feedback.
chatbot-admin-help-msg: Text for additional help or guidance in the admin section.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-question: Label in feedback email for the question posed to the chatbot.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-answer: Label in feedback email for the chatbot's response.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-references: Label in feedback email for resources used in the response.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-score: Label in feedback email for the feedback score.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-problems: Label in feedback email for identified problems.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-cause: Label in feedback email for the suspected cause of the problem.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-desc: Label in feedback email for the description of the problem.
chatbot-followup_short: Option to shorten the chatbot's answer.
chatbot-followup_elaborate: Option to elaborate on the chatbot's answer.
chatbot-followup_bulletpoints: Option to answer in bullet points.
chatbot-followup_onlytext: Option to answer in plain text only.
chatbot-followup_citations: Option to answer using direct citations.
chatbot-follow-up: Label for follow-up options in chatbot responses.
chatbot-attachments-popup-header: Header for a popup showing attachments related to the response.
chat-reference-attachments: Button text to display attachments in relation to a response.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-score-value-f: Text representing a 'fairly accurate' rating in feedback emails.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-score-value-i: Text representing an 'inaccurate' rating in feedback emails.
chatbot-feedback-mail-body-followup: Label in feedback email summarizing follow-up options chosen by the user.
chatbot-all-documents-popup-header: Header for a popup listing found sources or references.
chatbot-feedback-mail-context: Section in feedback email providing context from previous questions and answers.
chatbot-feedback-last: Section in feedback email summarizing the last evaluated question and answer.
chatbot-admin-module-stats-feedback-stat: Label for total queries in the statistics module.
chat-footer-disclaimer: Disclaimer text displayed in the chat footer.
